label: AEP 1 - Hammerfest
scope_note: Bounding box 23.40-24.12 E, 70.44-70.78 N. Urban / diffuse plus aquaculture sources into the Hammerfest coastal system.
notes: Rebuilt 2026-08-28; the former national AEP-001 was wiped. Sources: bottom-up inventory (aquaculture; vessel antifoulants; WWTP discharge; industrial emissions; anthropogenic and natural runoff), replacing the single pop-weighted REACH node on 2026-09-04. Atmospheric deposition direct to the fjord surface judged negligible for the box and omitted. Little measured point-source signal; the aquaculture belt carries most of the near-farm sediment monitoring. Southern edge lowered from 70.45 to 70.44 N on 2026-09-03 so the JERNELVA aquaculture locality (70.4496 N) is no longer clipped; also brings ~5 Vannmiljo sediment points near that farm into scope. 2026-09-08: aquaculture feed and antifoulant nodes merged to one Aquaculture node (89.9 kg/yr); magnitudes entered for Aquaculture, WWTP (16.89 kg/yr) and Industrial emissions (0.6 kg/yr to water); remaining source EPEQ still TODO.

label: AEP 2 - Repparfjord
scope_note: Bounding box 24.10-24.53 E, 70.42-70.52 N. Inner Repparfjorden: historic Folldal Verk submarine tailings plus Ulveryggen catchment runoff.
notes: Rebuilt 2026-08-28 from the former AEP-002 Repparfjorden. Highly contaminated inner-fjord sediment (Sternal 2017, class IV-V); not a copper exporter. River may or may not be a relevant source. Eastern edge extended from 24.42 to 24.53 E on 2026-09-01 to take in more of the river delta. Western edge was briefly widened to 23.90 E on 2026-09-02 then reverted. Western edge nudged from 24.13 to 24.10 E on 2026-09-03 to capture the mid-fjord Sternal 2017 sediment point (70.515 N, 24.112 E). 2026-09-04: N036 relabelled to "Natural catchment runoff" and an anthropogenic increment (Folldal Verk legacy weathering via Repparfjordelva) split out as N049. 2026-09-08: N036 relabelled to "Natural runoff" and N049 to "Anthropogenic runoff" to match AEP-1 labels; N003 tailings magnitude set to ~899 t Cu total (1 Mt tailings x 898.5 mg/kg Kleiv-2011 midpoint), a one-off 1972-78 discharge not a per-year rate.
